gravity.quote: microgravity combustion tests were performed aboard the International Space Station

flow.quote: Over most of the range of air ventilation rates (5-20 cm/s) comparable to spacecraft ventilation, upstream flame spread was the only viable flame.
flow.note: Spacecraft ventilation range; no single value is stated.

gravity.quote: On the Moon or Mars (0.17g and 0.38 g, respectively), where buoyant flows will be greater than 20 cm/s, the concurrent flame spread will be viable simultaneously with any opposed flow flame.
